name: dev-spec-driven
description: Unified, track-based spec-driven development: EARS requirements, technical design, traceable tasks, and approval-gated execution. Composes optional TDD, SaaS-scale, and AI-eval tracks per feature. Ships a fully local, zero-dependency MCP server for spec scaffolding, classification, status, task tracking, EARS linting, and traceability checks. No cloud, no CI, no cost.
